errors.text_span: tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.01, 0.02, or 0.03
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are not spaced at regular intervals. For example, the gap between 0.73 and 0.79 is 0.06, and between 0.79 and 0.82 is 0.03. The description oversimplifies the irregular spacing.
The description does not mention the different line styles (solid, dashed, dash-dot) or marker shapes (circle, diamond, square) used to distinguish the three data series.
The plot includes error bars for all data points on all three lines, which indicate variability. The description fails to mention this important feature.

errors.text_span: including a notable peak around 0.86 and a decline to near 0 at 0.91
errors.evidence: This description of the orange line is incorrect. The peak at 0.86 is minor (~0.16), while much larger peaks are at 0.91 (~0.4) and 0.94 (~0.45). The chart shows a major peak at 0.91, not a 'decline to near 0'.
The green line (Initial Accuracy) ends at an initial confidence of 1.00 with an accuracy value of approximately 0.9, not 0.7.
For the green line, the value at an initial confidence of 0.83 is approximately 0.65, not 0.4. The line does not drop to 0.4 in this region.
